articles.title: Parliament clears stricter anti-paper leak Bill with harsher penalties, fast-track courts
articles.summary: Parliament has approved amendments to India's anti-paper leak law, significantly tightening penalties for examination fraud and expanding enforcement powers. The revised legislation introduces special fast-track courts, empowers the Centre to set up a dedicated investigation task force, and broadens the scope of offences covered. The government says the changes aim to protect the integrity of public examinations and restore confidence among millions of students appearing for competitive tests.

articles.title: How AI Is powering India’s next generation of smart electricity grids
articles.summary: India's renewable capacity is scaling at a pace few grids have had to accommodate. But solar and wind are not dispatchable in the way coal and gas are, and a grid built around predictable baseload generation struggles to absorb large, variable inflows without instability. AI-based load forecasting and demand-response systems are what actually allow a distribution network to integrate high volumes of renewable energy reliably.

articles.title: A deep dive with Rs 84,084 crore scheme for offshore oil and gas exploration
articles.summary: The Cabinet approved an ₹84,084-crore scheme for offshore oil and gas exploration. This National Offshore Exploration Scheme, Samudra Manthan, will run until 2030-31. This initiative seeks to de-risk exploration for companies and increase production.
